module: Flowgraph node "Vec3" (repeat_instant category, tags vec3/vector/direction): builds a 3D vector. Number inputs "x", "y", "z" (0 by default); hidden input "rot" (quat): if it is linked, the output "value" is the vector (0,1,0) rotated by this quaternion (forward direction). Output "value" (vec3 as an {x,y,z} table).
notes: If 'rot' has a value, x/y/z are ignored.
drawMiddle displays the vector built from x/y/z (even if rot is used).

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the vector text (x,y,z) at the center of the node.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

work.desc: Computes the output: direction (0,1,0) rotated by 'rot' if present, otherwise {x,y,z}.
